mapper.sql: select w.warn_id, w.med_id, w.batch_id, w.batch_no, w.warn_type, w.warn_level, w.current_qty, w.warn_qty, w.warn_content, w.warn_time, w.handle_status, w.handle_user, w.handle_time, w.handle_remark, w.create_by, w.create_time, m.med_code, m.med_name, m.med_spec, m.unit from med_stock_warn w left join med_info m on m.med_id = w.med_id
mapper.select: select t.med_id, t.batch_id, t.batch_no, t.warn_type, t.warn_level, t.current_qty, t.warn_qty, t.warn_content from ( select m.med_id as med_id, null as batch_id, '' as batch_no, '0' as warn_type, case when ifnull(s.total_qty, 0) <= 0 then '2' else '1' end as warn_level, ifnull(s.total_qty, 0) as current_qty, m.stock_min as warn_qty, concat('药品【', m.med_name, '】当前库存 ', ifnull(s.total_qty, 0), ' ', ifnull(m.unit, ''), '，低于库存下限 ', m.stock_min, '，建议及时补货') as warn_content from med_info m left join med_stock s on s.med_id = m.med_id where m.status = '0' and ifnull(s.total_qty, 0) < ifnull(m.stock_min, 0) union all select m.med_id, null, '', '1', '0', ifnull(s.total_qty, 0), m.stock_max, concat('药品【', m.med_name, '】当前库存 ', ifnull(s.total_qty, 0), ' ', ifnull(m.unit, ''), '，高于库存上限 ', m.stock_max, '，注意库存积压') from med_info m inner join med_stock s on s.med_id = m.med_id where m.status = '0' and ifnull(m.stock_max, 0) > 0 and s.total_qty > m.stock_max union all select b.med_id, b.batch_id, b.batch_no, '2', case when to_days(b.expire_date) - to_days(curdate()) <= 30 then '1' else '0' end, b.remain_qty, to_days(b.expire_date) - to_days(curdate()), concat('药品【', m.med_name, '】批号 ', b.batch_no, ' 有效期至 ', date_format(b.expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), '，剩余 ', to_days(b.expire_date) - to_days(curdate()), ' 天，属于近效期药品，请优先使用') from med_stock_batch b inner join med_info m on m.med_id = b.med_id where b.batch_status = '1' and ifnull(b.remain_qty, 0) > 0 union all select b.med_id, b.batch_id, b.batch_no, '3', '2', b.remain_qty, 0, concat('药品【', m.med_name, '】批号 ', b.batch_no, ' 已于 ', date_format(b.expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 过期，剩余 ', ifnull(b.remain_qty, 0), ' ', ifnull(m.unit, ''), ' 待清理') from med_stock_batch b inner join med_info m on m.med_id = b.med_id where b.batch_status = '2' and ifnull(b.remain_qty, 0) > 0 ) t order by t.warn_type, t.med_id

select (select count(1) from med_stock_warn where handle_status = '0') as unhandleCount, (select count(1) from med_stock_warn where handle_status = '0' and warn_type = '0') as shortageCount, (select count(1) from med_stock_warn where handle_status = '0' and warn_type = '1') as overstockCount, (select count(1) from med_stock_warn where handle_status = '0' and warn_type = '2') as nearExpiryCount, (select count(1) from med_stock_warn where handle_status = '0' and warn_type = '3') as expiredCount, (select count(1) from med_stock_warn where handle_status = '0' and warn_level = '2') as seriousCount
